job.value: Catch up on activity and act on anything urgent

arrivedFrom.value: the Updates tab in the bottom bar

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Updates' with 'All / For action / Activity / Promos' filters and event rows reads as notifications.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The 'Buyer placed an order' row with a red '18hr left' pill and 'View order details' is the most urgent and most noticeable.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'View order details >' and 'Leave a review >' say exactly what happens.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Plain words throughout ('liked your item', 'started following you').

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Actions like shipping or reviewing are within what the person knows.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each row is one line plus at most one action link.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: All rows are recent activity for this account.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Short event lines and links; nothing to read through first.
